payload.title: ADR 0016: Insights
payload.context: M6 (#6): engagement metrics for published posts, read through channel adapters and fed back into drafting.
payload.rationale: Metric reading is an optional interface ReadsMetrics plus a capability list, so LinkedIn honestly has none until M9. A reading keeps null apart from zero. Snapshots are stored only when numbers change and polling stops after three weeks. One engagement score, a weighted sum of reactions, comments, shares and clicks without reach, is computed on read. Polling runs on its own queue, uses a bounded share of the channel rate limit and never changes a post or a channel status, so publishing keeps priority.
alternatives: fetchMetrics on ChannelAdapter for every platform
payload.consequences: Reach and clicks on Facebook need read_insights, which is not requested by default; reach is Meta's unique viewers metric. Replaces the fetchMetrics shape in the brief.
